title: Declaration Procedures and Unaccompanied Baggage
summary: The procedural requirements for declaring baggage, particularly unaccompanied baggage, have been tightened regarding the timeframe for declaration after arrival.

evolution.procedural_window: Shifted from 21 days to 3 days, then settled at 7 days.

member_objects.resolved_text:
৮। সকল যাত্রীর জন্য শুল্ক ঘোষণাপত্রের বিধান।— (১) বিদেশ হইতে আগত সকল যাত্রী শুল্ক কর্তৃপক্ষের নিকট তফসিল-১ এ বর্ণিত ফরম পূরণ করিয়া ব্যাগেজ ঘোষণা প্রদান করিতে হইবে।
(২) যাত্রীর সঙ্গে আনীত হয় নাই এমন ব্যাগেজ (unaccompanied baggage) এর ক্ষেত্রে কাস্টমস হল/শুল্ক এলাকা ত্যাগ করিবার পূর্বেই শুল্ক কর্তৃপক্ষের নিকট তফসিল-১ এ বর্ণিত ফরম পূরণ করিয়া ব্যাগেজ ঘোষণা প্রদান করিতে হইবে।
(৩) ভুলবশতঃ অথবা অন্য কোন অনিবার্য কারণে উপ-বিধি (১) ও উপ-বিধি (২) মোতাবেক ঘোষণা প্রদান করা সম্ভব না হইলে আগমনের তারিখ হইতে অনধিক ২১ (একুশ) দিনের মধ্যে সংশ্লিষ্ট সহকারী কমিশনারের নিম্নে নহেন এমন শুল্ক কর্মকর্তার নিকট তফসিল-১ এ বর্ণিত ফরম পূরণ করিয়া ব্যাগেজ ঘোষণা প্রদান করিতে পারিবে।
(৪) একজন যাত্রী ১ পঞ্জিকা বৎসরে ১ বার unaccompanied baggage আনিতে পারিবেন।

Baggage Declaration: All passengers arriving from abroad must submit a baggage declaration by completing the form prescribed in the first schedule to the customs authority.
In cases of unaccompanied baggage, the declaration must be submitted by completing the prescribed form before leaving the customs hall or customs area.

If a declaration cannot be filed due to inadvertent errors or unavoidable circumstances, passengers may submit the required form to a customs officer, who must be at least of the rank of Assistant Commissioner, within a specified number of days from the date of arrival.
Baggage: This clause sets out the formal requirements for declaring items brought by passengers, including unaccompanied baggage.
Passengers are permitted to import unaccompanied baggage only once per calendar year.
Appropriate Officer of Customs: A customs officer with a rank not lower than an Assistant Commissioner is authorized to accept delayed baggage declarations if the passenger was unable to provide them upon arrival due to unavoidable reasons.

Baggage Declaration: All passengers arriving from abroad are required to declare their baggage to the customs authorities using a specified form.
For unaccompanied baggage, the passenger must submit a declaration to the customs authority prior to exiting the customs hall or customs area.
If a declaration cannot be made upon arrival due to unavoidable circumstances, it may be submitted within a specified timeframe to an officer not below the rank of Assistant Commissioner of Customs.
Passenger Baggage Declaration Form: This is the official form prescribed under the rules for passengers to declare their personal belongings, jewelry, precious metals, currency, and other dutiable or non-dutiable items upon arrival.

The form requires comprehensive details including passenger identity, travel history, information on accompanied and unaccompanied baggage, and specific disclosures regarding high-value items like gold, silver, alcohol, tobacco, and foreign currency.
Assistant Commissioner of Customs: This officer is the minimum authorized authority to accept a delayed baggage declaration if the passenger was unable to file it upon arrival due to unavoidable reasons.
National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the authority responsible for prescribing the standard baggage declaration form to be used by all arriving passengers.
Baggage: Passengers are subject to specific limitations and requirements when importing unaccompanied baggage, which is restricted to a set frequency per calendar year.

For unaccompanied baggage, passengers must submit the required declaration form to the customs authorities before leaving the customs hall or designated customs area.

If a passenger fails to provide a declaration due to errors or unavoidable circumstances, they are permitted to submit the declaration form to an officer not below the rank of Assistant Commissioner of Customs within a specified period of days following their arrival.
Baggage Declaration Form: This form is the mandatory document prescribed in the first schedule for all passengers to declare their baggage to the customs authorities.
Customs: Customs authorities are the designated recipients of baggage declaration forms from incoming passengers.
Passengers must ensure that declarations for unaccompanied baggage are completed and submitted to the customs authorities before exiting the customs area.
Assistant Commissioner of Customs: Passengers who fail to declare baggage upon arrival may submit the required form to an officer not below the rank of Assistant Commissioner of Customs within the permitted timeframe.
Unaccompanied Baggage: Passengers are restricted to importing unaccompanied baggage only once per calendar year.
Declarations for unaccompanied baggage must be submitted to the customs authorities before the passenger leaves the customs hall or designated customs area.
